main_text.p: ܦܠܝܛܐ Syr. Æqualis, ad Philip. 2. 6. in Reg. Tre-mellius substantivè transtulit, Æqualitas.
פַּחַר, פַּחְרָא, ܦܚܪܐ Ch. & Syr. Figulus: Item Testa figulina.
פַּחַת פַּחְתָּא Ch. Fossa, fovea. Plur. פַּחֲתָן Fossulæ, profunditates fœdæ.
פַּטְל פְּטְלוֹן Folium, Massa auri. Respondet Hebraeo כֻּתֹּם, Iobi 28. 16. 19. Videtur esse Græc. πέταλον, πέτηλον.
פַּטֵּם Pahel Ch. Saginare, pinguefacere. Ithpahel אִתְפַּטֵּם Saginari.
פְּטִים Ch. Pinguis, Saginatus. Plur. פְּטִימִין, פְּטִימַיָּא. Fœmin. פְּטִימְתָּא. Plur. פְּטִימָתָא, פְּטִימָן.
פִּטְמָא Ch. ܦܛܡܐ Syr. Saginatio, pinguefactio, pinguedo.
פִּטּוּמָא Ch. Mixtura, conditura, confectura aromatica, Exod. 25. 6. in Jonath.
פַּטְקָא פִּטְקָא Ch. Liber, epistola. Plur. פִּטְקִין פִּטְקָיָא, & פִּטְקִיָּא, Numer. 11. 26. in Jon.

פְּטַר Ch. Mittere, dimittere, remittere: Dimitti, discedere, migrare, emigrare; unde apud Rabbinos in Niphal est Dimitti, Migrare ex hac vita, Mori. Ex qua significatione est illud Syr. ܠܡܦܛܪ Dimitti cupio, ad Philip. 1. 23. Sic in Targ. sumitur, Cant. 1. 1. 7. Ithpehal אִתְפְּטַר Dimitti, discedere.

page.notes: Hebrew, Syriac, Chaldee and Greek words are transcribed approximately from the scan; vocalisation and Syriac forms are doubtful and should be checked against the original. Catchword absent.
